speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the breast mass you found, specifically regarding its size, texture, and whether it causes any pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the mass feel fixed to the underlying tissue or skin, and have you noticed any nipple discharge or skin changes like dimpling? I also need to know if you have a family history of breast or ovarian cancer.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the rapid growth, could you tell me if you are currently pregnant or recently postpartum? I also need to know if you have a personal or family history of breast cancer.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Mammogram
REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound_Breast

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast.

speaker: Doctor
text: The mammogram shows a smooth polylobulated mass, which is concerning for a phyllodes tumor given the rapid growth. I will request an ultrasound to further characterize the mass's internal structure and vascularity. REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound_Breast

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the ultrasound is normal and the mass is rapidly growing, I need to know if you are currently breastfeeding or have recently stopped, as this helps rule out a galactocele or lactating adenoma. Please also confirm your current hormonal status, such as whether you are on any hormone replacement therapy.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, night sweats, or changes in appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text: I note the absence of systemic symptoms, but given the rapid growth and mammographic findings, I need to rule out malignancy via tissue sampling. REQUEST TEST: Core_Needle_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Biopsy Microscopic Description: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings of leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth are classic for this diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor
